doc.intent: GBC color response, panel persistence and the LCD subpixel grid, one grid cell per game pixel
doc.core_options: A variant whose pipeline has a colour-matrix pass turns Gambatte's own GBC colour correction off, so GBC colours pass the Pokefan531 matrix once; the authentic variant has no matrix and, like shaders off, keeps Gambatte's correction. The launcher writes these into the core options file each launch.
